objective: T-20260929-12 (autonomous-queue.md, 交互会话): can a stock-level ensemble of our existing factors (T-15's 259 zoo columns + 12 batch factors, static selection from a 2016-06-01..2023-12-29 select window only) built into a long-only top-50 book, then HEDGED with a long position in an inverse ETF (SH=-1x SPY or PSQ=-1x QQQ, trailing-63-session-beta-sized), raise the Sharpe of the S3 incumbent when combined with it -- i.e. does hedging turn an already-refuted correlated long-only sleeve into an uncorrelated diversifier. Judged on screen_lane.py's own diversifier-edge test (combined vs vol-matched S3 control) in the OOS window 2024-01-02..2026-09-08, decided at the median of rebalance offsets {0,5,10,15} sessions after month-end, 10bp/20bp costs, next-open fill.
target_regime_and_horizon: Stock-level cross-sectional ensemble, monthly rebalance, top-1000-by-ADV broad U.S. universe (open_composer.research.signal_card.load_market, top_n=1000), same universe/labels as T-15. Hedge overlay uses actual SH/PSQ daily prices from data/sip/daily (both symbols on file 2016-2026, checked before writing this review) so real decay/fees are included, not a synthetic -1x. OOS test window 2024-01-02..2026-09-08 (Stage 1); walk-forward stress 2018-01-02..2023-09-15 (Stage 2, only if Stage 1 passes).
existing_solution_comparison: Read both required prior-art rows and their evidence files in full before designing anything. (1) dir:ml_ranking_liquid500_recent_vs_momentum_rule (reports/research/control/step13-recent-high-return-2026-09.md): a screened top-40-by-recent-ICIR public-factor-library portfolio scored the best validation IC of any Step-13 configuration (0.035) but only translated to 17.5-19.4% annualized in a LONG-ONLY top-50 book, roughly half a simple momentum rule's 33.7% and below SPMO's 37.4% -- refuted as a standalone long-only strategy, but never tested as a hedged/decorrelated sleeve, and never combined with S3. (2) dir:baseline_chain_b0_b1_b2_market_neutral_vs_long (reports/research/control/step11-2026-09-06-progress.md, step11-w2-model-ranking-2026-09.md): every level of a momentum/ridge/LightGBM chain was tested long-only AND SPY-beta-hedged market-neutral; the market-neutral (beta-hedge) variant was uniformly WORSE at every level (1/8 gates each, one config's capture_vm went negative) -- 'the hedge leg is a systematic drag, not a risk reducer, at weekly rebalance.' Directly on point: that hedge used SPY-beta-neutrality (short SPY notional, not an actual inverse ETF position) at weekly frequency; this task tests a materially different implementation (actual long SH/PSQ shares, monthly rebalance, hedge ratio beta/(1+beta) capped [0,1.5] rather than full beta-neutral 1.0) explicitly to see if the prior drag finding is specific to that construction. Also checked and cited: dir:equity_momentum_concentrated_pwb (K2 diversifier edge -0.143 anchor / -0.071 stress against vol-matched S3+SHY, a LONG-ONLY concentrated momentum book) and dir:factor_style_etf_momentum_rotation (K2 edge -0.15 to -0.31 despite only 0.66-0.72 correlation with S3) -- both show that merely being long-only and moderately correlated with S3 is sufficient to fail the diversifier test even without extreme correlation, which is exactly the mechanism this task's brief names as the reason every long-only candidate so far has failed to add Sharpe to S3 (correlation 0.5-0.8). Web check (2026-09-29, this review): searched 'ProShares Short S&P500 SH daily rebalancing decay tracking error' and 'hedging long-only equity factor portfolio with inverse ETF versus shorting index futures beta hedge decay' -- confirms SH/PSQ carry real path-dependent compounding decay and elevated tracking error (SH 1y/3y/5y tracking error 5.75/6.81/8.72% vs ETF median ~1.4-1.6%, ProShares' own guidance: inverse ETFs 'fit one specific use case: short-term tactical hedging only') and that shorting index futures is the theoretically cleaner hedge but unavailable to this retail account -- this is why the brief requires using actual SH/PSQ prices (fees+decay priced in) rather than a synthetic -1x SPY series, and is a material, named risk to the hedged forms' Sharpe independent of whether the underlying factor ensemble has real alpha.
remaining_evidence_gap: Whether the specific combination (a) a STATIC select-window-only ensemble of T-15's already-scanned factors (no re-scan, no new IC computation) and (b) a monthly, capped-beta, actual-SH/PSQ hedge (not SPY-beta-neutral) produces a return stream with correlation to S3 low enough (<0.3, vs the 0.5-0.8 typical of long-only candidates) and Sharpe positive enough, on 2024-2026 OOS data, to clear the lane's diversifier edge bar (+0.05) against a vol-matched S3 control. Nothing in the registry has tested a hedged (not beta-neutral-short) stock ensemble against the diversifier-edge metric before; this is the first test of 'hedge to decorrelate, then check diversifier value' rather than 'hedge to reduce risk' (which is what baseline_chain tested and which failed).
negative_experiments_checked: In addition to the two required rows and their two cited siblings above: dir:owner_azevedo_hoegner_ml_anomalies_2023 and dir:owner_interacting_anomalies_muller_schmickler_2025 (both long-short anomaly-combination papers, already ruled refuted-by-local-precedent because the same screen-a-factor-library-then-rank mechanism already lost to a momentum baseline on this project's 2018-2026 US data) -- neither introduces a hedge-then-diversify design, so they do not pre-empt this task, but they confirm the underlying factor-combination step itself is not expected to produce a large standalone long-short edge; this task's hypothesis rests entirely on decorrelation from S3 via the hedge, not on the ensemble suddenly becoming a strong long-short signal. dir:step10_cross_asset_trend_tsmom_etf and dir:international_country_etf_momentum_rotation checked for any prior SH/PSQ usage as a hedge leg -- none found; this is the first use of SH/PSQ as a hedge instrument in this registry.
cost_and_execution_assumptions: Reuses scripts/screen_lane.py's frozen conventions unmodified: WINDOWS (anchor 2024-01-08..2026-09-17, stress 2016-05-02..2023-09-15 -- Stage 1 anchor here is truncated to the brief's 2024-01-02..2026-09-08 as instructed by the queue task, computed via the same evaluate_offset_window/offset_summary machinery), COST_BPS_PRIMARY=10.0 / COST_BPS_STRESS=20.0, MONTHLY_OFFSETS (reduced per the brief to {0,5,10,15}, a documented reduction from the full 21 for compute, median reported), s3_incumbent(), combine_two_sleeves(), diversifier_edge_for_offset(), correlation_with_s3(), judged_offset() and DIVERSIFIER_SHARPE_EDGE_MIN=0.10 imported unmodified -- NOTE the queue brief's own pass bar is +0.05, looser than screen_lane's own module-level constant 0.10; this review follows the brief's explicit instruction (+0.05) as the frozen pass/fail bar for this iteration, and reports the 0.10 comparison as additional context, not as the gate. Stock leg: signal at month-end close (tranche.shifted_signal_dates, reused unmodified), fill at next session's open, monthly top-50 equal weight from the ensemble score, 10bp/20bp cost on turnover. Hedge leg: trailing 63-session daily beta of the stock book's returns to SPY, computed at each rebalance from PAST returns only (no look-ahead), weight on SH/PSQ = beta/(1+beta) capped to [0,1.5], weight on stocks = 1/(1+beta); SH and PSQ are real priced ETFs from data/sip/daily (SH 2016-06-27..2026-09-28, PSQ/SPY/QQQ 2016-01-04..2026-09-28, confirmed present before writing this review).
stop_condition: Stage 1 (2024-01-02..2026-09-08 OOS only): continue to Stage 2 only if some hedged form (b or b') has diversifier edge vs vol-matched S3 >= +0.05 (median over offsets), standalone Sharpe > 0, and correlation with S3 < 0.3. Otherwise the direction is refuted at Stage 1 and Stage 2 (the 2018-2023 walk-forward stress re-selection) is not run. Stage 2, if reached, passes only if the edge is also >= +0.05 in 2018-01-02..2023-09-15 using a yearly-expanding walk-forward re-selection (not the frozen select-window selection) -- both windows passing is required before any forward-shadow is proposed; this review does not create one.

hedging long-only equity factor portfolio with inverse ETF versus shorting index futures beta hedge decay

sources.claim: ProShares inverse ETFs (including SH, -1x S&P 500) have a one-day investment objective; for any holding period other than one day, realized return can be higher or lower than the Daily Target because of compounding -- smaller index gains/losses and higher index volatility push returns worse than the Daily Target, while larger index moves and lower volatility push returns better than the Daily Target. ProShares' own guidance: investors should monitor inverse-ETF holdings 'as frequently as daily' and consider a rebalancing strategy, i.e. these instruments are built for short-horizon tactical use, not a static multi-year hedge.
sources.applicability: Direct, material caveat for this task's hedged forms (b)/(b'): even a correctly-sized beta hedge implemented via SH/PSQ carries a real decay/tracking-error cost that a synthetic -1x return series would not show; this is why the brief requires actual SH/PSQ prices and why a positive edge, if found, must be checked against this known drag rather than assumed clean.
sources.limitations: Vendor (issuer) published guidance, not independent peer-reviewed research; no exact publication date on the page itself (fetched_at used as the reference date); does not disclose a specific backtest of a monthly-rebalanced, beta-sized hedge overlay on a factor book (this iteration's exact construction).
sources.independent_replication: Not independently re-derived here; the compounding/path-dependency mechanism described is the same one documented across the broader leveraged/inverse-ETF literature (e.g. Cheng & Madhavan 2009), not separately opened this pass.

cheapest_decisive_test.action: Build 5 static ensembles (E10/E20/E40/E20D/R40) from T-15's already-computed select-window ICIR/sign (reports/research/iterations/h20260928_15_claude_factor_batch/select-results.json, no new IC scan), form long-only top-50 monthly books and hedged (SH, PSQ) variants using screen_lane's reused s3_incumbent/combine_two_sleeves/diversifier_edge_for_offset, and read off the median-offset diversifier edge vs vol-matched S3 in 2024-01-02..2026-09-08 for every hedged form.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: At least one hedged (b or b') candidate has diversifier edge >= +0.05, standalone Sharpe > 0, and correlation with S3 < 0.3 in the Stage 1 OOS window.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: No hedged candidate clears all three Stage-1 bars -- direction refuted for this scope without running Stage 2.
